name: weighingms
description: WeighingMS — assisted dyestuff weighing station (training build with Dummy APIs)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix playwright install && npx --prefix playwright playwright install chromium && VIRTUAL_ENV= poetry install
scripts.check: npm run check:py && npm run check:web
scripts.check:py: .venv/bin/ruff format --check src tests scripts && .venv/bin/ruff check src tests scripts && .venv/bin/mypy && .venv/bin/pytest --cov --cov-report=term-missing
